patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff only adds pattern-fuzzer corpus files and does not touch src/lib/lwan-config.c. Fixed-side evidence therefore comes from the clean n132/arvo:18626-fix image, whose source at this site already carries the missing guard.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `lex_multiline_string()` may execute `strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)`, the parser span must still contain at least three bytes starting at `lexer->pos`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the terminator probe with `lexer->pos` already past `lexer->end`, so the required span check is false (`remaining_bytes=-1`, `compare_len=3`). The authoritative fixed image reaches the same source probe with the guard satisfied (`remaining_bytes=25`, `compare_len=3`) and executes the protected `strncmp` cleanly.

nodes.description: At the vulnerable `strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)` sink, the 3-byte terminator probe exceeds the bytes remaining in the parser span.
nodes.evidence: The frozen vulnerable trace records `compare_len=3` and `remaining_bytes=-1` at `terminator_probe_sink`.

edges.relation: The same parser-end pointer materialized in `config_init_data()` is later compared against `lexer->pos` at the terminator probe site.
The pointer state produced immediately after consuming the remaining opening quotes is the same pointer later passed into the 3-byte `strncmp` terminator probe.
